story.title: Story 7: Reopen and Degraded Archive State

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the prior client-side derived-view shim finding and the directly touched archive bootstrap/rendering surfaces. I inspected the updated archive bootstrap path, derived-view section renderer, archive state schema, and updated client/server tests, then reran targeted archive tests plus the configured story and epic gates on the changed workspace.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `apps/platform/client/app/bootstrap.ts:1125-1166` now records `derivedViews: null` plus a separate `derivedViewsError` when the derived-view request fails instead of fabricating a fallback structural view. `apps/platform/client/features/processes/derived-archive-views-section.ts:16-37` renders that failure as an explicit error state with no derived-view rows, and `tests/service/client/archive-router.test.ts:127-154` now asserts the archive/turn surfaces remain visible while `[data-derived-archive-view-id]` stays absent. Fresh targeted tests, `corepack pnpm run green-verify`, and `corepack pnpm run verify-all` all passed on the updated code.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/service/client/archive-router.test.ts tests/service/client/derived-archive-views.test.ts tests/service/client/archive-turns-section.test.ts tests/service/server/archive-api.test.ts tests/service/server/derived-archive-view.test.ts tests/service/server/turn-derivation.test.ts --environment jsdom

additionalObservations: The archive bootstrap path now preserves canonical archive and turn data while surfacing derived-view failure as a dedicated section-level error, which matches the story’s degraded-read intent without inventing runtime data.
`guard:no-test-changes` and `test:e2e` still complete as scaffolded `SKIP` steps in the repo scripts, but the executable portions of both configured gates passed cleanly.
